sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back after their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games and have won 7 of their last 6 matches before the defeat, so this should be a strong opportunity against the struggling visitors currently bottom with just 4 points. Alsager have won only once in their last five outings, making them vulnerable to a Sandbach side keen to reassert their dominance.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-dwellers Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall (6th) in a clash between mid-table contenders. Title-race relevance also extends to Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points), who visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before facing Brereton Social in a midweek fixture on Wednesday; both sides will be keen to maintain momentum in a congested top half. Elsewhere, Bilston Town host Foley Meir on Saturday with both teams showing recent form, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter searching for their first win after a run of five consecutive losses. Crewe face Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (both struggling sides near the bottom), Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a lower-mid-table encounter, and Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social, with Widnes pointless and winless from seven games. A Wednesday midweek fixture sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community.
